chapter: Recent years and early piano influences
title: Eddie Steele and Lucky Roberts in his building
summary: He recalls a blind pianist, Eddie Steele, upstairs and Lucky Roberts downstairs when he was about 13.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: The earliest recollection I have of a blind pianist was a pianist named Eddie Steele. It's funny, where I lived in

my apartment as a child, he lived upstairs, and he used to practice, and he played a fine piano at the time. And downstairs, in the other house on the ground floor, was the old-time pianist... Oh, what was...
Downstairs Lucky Roberts was the pianist.
What sort of piano did Eddie Steele play?
He played Classical piano, and he also played Stride piano; you know, the piano style of the day.
Did you get to know him?
At that time, no, because I was too... I was playing handball at that time.
I was about 13. 13 years old. And I would be playing handball... Besides playing my ukelele!
Oh, yes, you were still on that.
Yeah, and you know how that was. I was going backwards again.
